title: Margaret Lea Robinson
text:
I am a PhD candidate in the Integrated Program in Biochemistry at the University of Wisconsin–Madison[cite: 1] and an NIH T32 Biotechnology Training Program trainee in the Coon Lab[cite: 1]. My research develops proteomics methodology and bioinformatics tools to study metabolism and human disease[cite: 1].
